name: 广泛性焦虑障碍量表
instructions: 在过去的两周里，你有多频繁地被以下问题所困扰？请根据实际情况选择最符合的一项。
instructionsEn: Over the last two weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems? Please choose the option that best matches your actual situation.

items.textEn: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
Not being able to stop or control worrying

items.text: 对各种各样的事情担忧过多
items.textEn: Worrying too much about different things
Being so restless that it is hard to sit still

items.text: 感到似乎将有可怕的事情发生而害怕
items.textEn: Feeling afraid as if something awful might happen

totalBands.description: 目前没有明显的焦虑症状。
存在轻度焦虑症状，建议关注并适时自我调节。
存在中度焦虑症状，建议寻求专业心理评估。
存在重度焦虑症状，请尽快寻求专业医疗帮助。
